text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Narita Brian isn't participating in this race, Mayano Top Gun uses it as an opportunity to show her just how much she has grown. Fired up, she heads to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon brings Narita Brian to the racecourse so she can watch Mayano Top Gun race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian privately keeps her eyes on Mayano Top Gun. With her watching, the Takarazuka Kinen begins.
